hooks.command: printf '%s' "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qiE '(error|exception|traceback|segfault|SIGABRT|panic|fatal|FAILED|Error:)' && [ ! -f .tot/sessions/*.jsonl ] 2>/dev/null && echo '[tot-mcp] Detected a failure pattern. Consider using /tot-reason to systematically investigate with Tree of Thought reasoning.' || true

ls .tot/sessions/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q . && node -p "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d='.tot/sessions';const files=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.jsonl'));const active=files.filter(f=>{const lines=fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,f),'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean);const last=JSON.parse(lines[lines.length-1]);return last.payload?.status==='active'||lines.some(l=>JSON.parse(l).type==='session-created'&&!lines.some(l2=>JSON.parse(l2).type==='session-completed'))});if(active.length)console.log('[tot-mcp] Active reasoning session detected. Use /tot-inspect to view or /tot-reason to continue.')" 2>/dev/null || true
